title: 实验室里的行为规范
source_doc: course/Chemical Spillage & Response/03_Behavior Lab Safety Video Part 3.md
author_source: project/Chemical Spillage & Response/03_Behavior Lab Safety Video Part 3/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在整洁的实验台前，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a tidy lab bench and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲实验室里的行为规范。

shots.scene: 阿杰一手拿面包，一手端着烧杯走进实验室
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks into the lab holding a sandwich in one hand and a beaker in the other.
shots.narration: 阿杰边吃早饭，边走进实验室。

shots.scene: 台面上堆满瓶子，地上还放着一瓶试剂
shots.prompt_en: A cluttered lab bench piled with bottles, and a reagent bottle with a blank label sitting on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 他的台面乱糟糟，地上还放着试剂瓶。

shots.scene: 小研皱眉看着，指了指门口的禁止饮食标志
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student frowns and points at a no eating and drinking sign by the lab door.
shots.narration: 小研摇摇头：这样太危险了。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰、老周围在实验台旁友好交谈
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, the young male student and the older man talk together at a lab bench.
shots.narration: 尊重实验室，也尊重身边的同伴。

shots.scene: 欣欣双手比出一个大圆，圈住所有人
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot spreads both arms wide in a big circle gesture.
shots.narration: 每个人的行为，决定大家是否安全。

shots.scene: 小研打开一份空白的标准操作规程，逐条打勾
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a blank standard operating procedure binder and ticks steps one by one.
shots.narration: 严格按书面操作规程，一步一步做。

shots.scene: 跳过步骤的箭头被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an arrow skipping over a step in a numbered list, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不跳步，不凭感觉改步骤。

shots.scene: 禁止饮食标志
shots.prompt_en: A no eating and drinking sign on a white wall. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里，不吃东西、不喝水。

shots.scene: 口香糖、口红、水杯三个图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons crossed out with red X marks: chewing gum, a lipstick and a drinking cup. No people.
shots.narration: 不嚼口香糖，也不化妆。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手拿水杯，杯口沾上污点的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a gloved hand holding a drinking cup with chemical stains on its rim, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 有毒化学品可能沾上皮肤、吃进嘴里。

shots.scene: 培养皿和样品上落下碎屑，结果图表变红
shots.prompt_en: Crumbs falling into an open sample dish next to a blank result chart turning red. No people.
shots.narration: 还会污染样品，毁掉实验结果。

shots.scene: 深夜实验室只有阿杰一人，墙上时钟指向很晚
shots.prompt_en: The young male student works alone in a dark lab late at night under a single lamp, a wall clock in the background.
shots.narration: 不要一个人在实验室里做实验。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰同在实验室，彼此能看见
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student work at nearby benches within sight of each other.
shots.narration: 至少有一个同伴在场，出事能互相帮忙。

shots.scene: 乱糟糟的实验室图标上方亮起警示三角
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a messy lab room with clutter everywhere and a yellow warning triangle above it. No people.
shots.narration: 杂乱的实验室，就是危险的实验室。

shots.scene: 地上一团纸，一只脚即将踩上
shots.prompt_en: A crumpled paper towel on the lab floor with a foot about to step on it. No people.
shots.narration: 地上的废纸杂物会让人滑倒、绊倒。

shots.scene: 阿杰弯腰捡起纸团丢进垃圾桶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up the paper towel and drops it into a waste bin.
shots.narration: 看到了，就马上清理掉。

shots.scene: 地上放着两瓶试剂的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two reagent bottles standing on the floor next to a bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 试剂瓶不要放在地上，

shots.scene: 阿杰把地上的试剂瓶放回台面的托盘里
shots.prompt_en: The young male student lifts a reagent bottle from the floor and places it in a tray on the bench.
shots.narration: 哪怕只是临时放一下，也不行。

shots.scene: 小研翻开一份空白的安全技术说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a blank safety data sheet next to a small spill on the floor.
shots.narration: 万一洒了，先查安全技术说明书。

shots.scene: 拖把清理地面，旁边立着小心地滑警示牌
shots.prompt_en: A mop cleans a small wet patch on the floor beside a yellow wet floor caution sign. No people.
shots.narration: 一般的洒漏立即清理，放好防滑警示。

shots.scene: 大量溢洒的图标旁出现电话和撤离箭头
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a large spill with a telephone icon and an arrow pointing to the exit. No people.
shots.narration: 量大或不清楚性质，撤离并报告。

shots.scene: 小研的台面上只有几样需要的器材，整整齐齐
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works at a neat bench with only a few needed items arranged in order.
shots.narration: 台面保持整洁，只放需要的东西。

shots.scene: 不用的瓶子被收回柜子里
shots.prompt_en: Unused bottles are put back into a closed cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 用不着的，都收起来。

shots.scene: 台边的烧杯被胳膊碰落的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an elbow knocking a beaker off the edge of a bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 东西放在台边，一碰就掉。

shots.scene: 手把烧杯往台面里侧推
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand pushes a beaker back from the edge toward the middle of the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 把它们往里放。

shots.scene: 徒手捡碎玻璃的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand picking up broken glass shards, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 碎玻璃，绝不能徒手捡。

shots.scene: 玻璃划破手指，化学品随伤口进入的示意
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of a glass shard cutting a finger with chemical drops entering the cut. No people.
shots.narration: 割伤会让化学品直接进入血液。

shots.scene: 小研戴厚手套，用刷子和簸箕扫起碎玻璃
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing thick gloves and goggles, sweeps broken glass into a dustpan with a brush.
shots.narration: 戴好手套，用刷子和簸箕清扫。

shots.scene: 碎玻璃倒进一个空白标签的硬纸收集箱
shots.prompt_en: Broken glass is poured from a dustpan into a sturdy cardboard broken glass box with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 碎玻璃放进专用的收集容器。

shots.scene: 小研在水槽边清洗玻璃器皿，放上晾干架
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student washes glassware at a lab sink and places it on a drying rack.
shots.narration: 实验结束，把玻璃器皿洗净晾干。

shots.scene: 小研把试剂瓶放回试剂柜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts reagent bottles back into a labeled storage cabinet with blank tags.
shots.narration: 试剂放回原来的储存位置。

shots.scene: 小研用喷壶和纸巾擦拭台面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the bench surface with a spray bottle and paper towels.
shots.narration: 再用乙醇或异丙醇擦净台面。

shots.scene: 阿杰发现电线破损，转身去找老周
shots.prompt_en: The young male student notices a frayed power cord on the bench and turns to find the older man.
shots.narration: 看到违规或不安全的情况，

shots.scene: 阿杰向老周报告，老周点头记录
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reports to the older man, who nods and writes in a blank notebook.
shots.narration: 立即报告导师或实验室负责人。

shots.scene: 禁止吸烟标志
shots.prompt_en: A no smoking sign on a white wall. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里严禁吸烟。

shots.scene: 实验室冰箱里放饭盒的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a lunch box inside a lab refrigerator, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 食物饮料不带进来，冰箱不放食品。

shots.scene: 嘴对移液管吸液的图标被红叉划掉，旁边是洗耳球打勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of mouth pipetting crossed out with a red X, next to a pipette with a rubber bulb with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 移液用移液器或洗耳球，绝不用嘴吸。

shots.scene: 凑近瓶口闻、用舌头尝的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a nose sniffing directly at a bottle mouth and a tongue near a beaker, both crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 不直接闻，更不尝化学品。

shots.scene: 两人在实验室追逐打闹的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two people running and playing around in a lab, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里不奔跑、不打闹。

shots.scene: 加热中的烧杯旁空无一人的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a beaker heating on a hot plate with nobody around, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 加热和反应进行中，不离开岗位。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白审批单上签字
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator signs a blank approval form at his desk.
shots.narration: 危险实验不能一个人做。

shots.scene: 月亮和日历图标旁出现审批印章
shots.prompt_en: A moon icon and a calendar icon next to a blank approval stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 夜间、节假日做实验，按本校规定报批。

shots.scene: 废液倒进贴空白标签的废液桶，倒进水槽被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Liquid waste is poured into a labeled waste container with a blank label; an icon of pouring into a sink drain is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 洗器皿前，残液先倒进废液桶。

shots.scene: 酒精喷壶旁的火焰图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A spray bottle of alcohol next to a flame icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 酒精易燃，擦台面要远离明火热源。

shots.scene: 小研离开前关水龙头、关电源、关气阀
shots.prompt_en: Before leaving, the female graduate student turns off the tap, switches off the power strip and closes a gas valve.
shots.narration: 离开前，关好水、电、气。

shots.scene: 小研关灯锁门
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student switches off the lights and locks the lab door.
shots.narration: 关好门窗，再离开。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起大拇指，身后实验室整洁有序
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up in front of a clean, orderly lab.
shots.narration: 安全，从规范自己的行为做起。

shots.scene: 欣欣指向一排化学品危险象形图
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a row of chemical hazard pictograms on a blank board.
shots.narration: 下一课，认识常见的化学品危害。

shots.scene: SOP、禁止饮食、同伴三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a procedure binder, a no eating and drinking sign and two people side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 按规程做，不饮食，不单独做。

shots.scene: 整洁台面、地面无杂物、试剂不落地图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a tidy bench, a clean floor and a reagent bottle on a shelf instead of the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 台面整洁，地面干净，试剂不落地。

shots.scene: 簸箕扫玻璃、废液桶、报告图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a dustpan with broken glass, a waste container and a person reporting. No people.
shots.narration: 碎玻璃不徒手，废液回收，隐患报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整洁的实验室门口挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the door of a clean, orderly lab.
shots.narration: 好习惯保安全，下次见！
